source.stem: Which statement about bonding is not correct?

options.text: Carbon can form four single covalent bonds.
Chlorine atoms react to gain a noble gas electronic structure.
Covalent bonding involves losing and gaining electrons.
Hydrogen molecules have the formula H₂.

packed_tags.subject: science
packed_tags.topic: States of matter, particles and water

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Water vapour in the air turns into liquid droplets by evaporation.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Water vapour forms droplets whenever it touches a glass, even if the glass is warmer than the air.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The glass becomes cold because water vapour turns into droplets on it.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Dew on leaves is not condensation; condensation happens only on glass.

intelligence.enrichment: When water vapour in the air touches a cold surface, it changes into liquid water droplets by condensation. A cold surface cools nearby water vapour in air, causing it to become liquid droplets on that surface. The learner correctly applies this rule: When water vapour in the air touches a cold surface, it changes into liquid water droplets by condensation. Water seen on a glass must have leaked from the water or ice inside it.
